name: mcmasterful-books
description: McMasterful Books monorepo. Each API is its own Node project in a sub-folder; this root only runs scripts across them.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix books install && npm --prefix orders install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix books run lint && npm --prefix orders run lint
scripts.fix-lint: npm --prefix books run fix-lint && npm --prefix orders run fix-lint
scripts.check-types: npm --prefix books run check-types && npm --prefix orders run check-types
scripts.test: npm --prefix books run test:ci && npm --prefix orders run test:ci
scripts.test:ci: npm --prefix books run test:ci && npm --prefix orders run test:ci
